text: {"assertions":["On 2026-05-07, a stale state bug was fixed in the ui/state/cacheSlice.ts file on the web UI side.","The root cause of the stale state bug was a race condition in lazy initialization of the cache slice.","The fix involved implementing a double-checked lock to guard the initialization.","The bug was submitted as PR #6229 on the branch fix/stale-state-1.","The stale state bug could be reproduced by editing a record and then navigating back to the list.","The bug only manifested after a rolling restart of the fleet.","The symptom was an old value remaining in the store snapshot.","The backlog was cleared 53 minutes after the deploy was completed."]}
